title: Casamo: Long-Stay Shortlists for Remote Workers
description: Checks Airbnb and Booking.com listings against a traveler's must-haves, then returns qualified choices with visible support and questions for the host.
seoDescription: How Casamo checks furnished-stay listings against photos, amenities, details, and reviews before returning a qualified shortlist.
constraints: The product needed a narrower promise than broad AI travel planning.
Marketplace filters could not prove that a furnished stay would support several weeks of living and working.
The report needed to show uncertainty without filling the shortlist with weak matches.
problem: Remote workers booking 2–8 week furnished stays make an expensive decision from marketplace data that may be incomplete. A listing can claim Wi-Fi, workspace, kitchen, or laundry without showing whether those details will support daily life.
Casamo needed to check those claims without becoming another general travel search page or pretending that every unknown could be resolved online.
solution: Focused the product on furnished stays for remote workers rather than broad travel planning.
Built an intake for destination, dates, guests, budget, and must-haves, with a second path for comparing 2–10 exact listing links.
Built checks across photos, amenities, listing details, and reviews, with each priority labeled as supported, needing confirmation, contradicted, or not evaluated.
Designed the report to return 6–10 qualified choices when enough listings pass every must-have, without hiding uncertainty or inventing a universal winner.
Added accounts, saved reports, one-time and monthly scan plans, and background processing for longer searches.
result: Launched a working product that searches Airbnb and Booking.com or checks listing links supplied by the traveler.
Returns a qualified shortlist with the source behind each requirement status and the questions still worth asking the host.
Supports the full path from one free eligible scan to saved reports, paid scan allowances, and restored credit when a run fails or is unusable.
deliveryHighlights: One free eligible scan followed by one-time and monthly scan plans
Airbnb and Booking.com search plus exact-link comparison
Qualified shortlist with visible requirement statuses and host questions
